archive_description: Store finished campaigns and decks in the database. These could then be compiled into profiles.
archive_new_description: Choose the campaign you want to archive.
archive_chaos_reinit_confirm: Replace the chaos bag with this difficulty's starting tokens?
archive_history_help: Snapshots of this campaign, taken when you leave the editor and before changing its campaign, restoring or deleting it (the 10 most recent). Restoring replaces this campaign with the chosen snapshot; the version it replaces is kept here too.
archive_history_empty: No autosaves yet — leave the editor after a change to create one.
archive_history_restore_confirm: Replace this campaign with the selected autosave? Your current version will be overwritten.
archive_change_campaign_confirm: Changing the campaign will clear all campaign logs. Continue?
archive_delete_confirm: Are you sure? This cannot be undone.
archive_no_campaigns: You have no archived campaigns yet.
archive_created: New Archived Campaign created — you're now editing it.
archive_players_auto_save_help: Changes in this tab are saved automatically. Adding or removing players, assigning deck owners, and updating permissions take effect immediately.
archive_logs_no_campaign: Select a campaign to manage logs.
archive_logs_no_data: No log data available for this campaign.
archive_ach_tip_extra: Checked for you from your recorded campaign data (more than the log alone). Tap to see what it checks.
archive_ach_tip_log: Checked for you from your recorded campaign logs. Tap to see what it checks.
archive_ach_tip_manual: You check this off as 'Earned' yourself.
archive_ach_extra_hint: Could be automatically checked from combination of data of other tabs than the log alone.
archive_ach_prereq_warn: Expected prerequisite not found in your recorded logs.
archive_ach_modal_extra: Checked for you from your recorded campaign data (more than the log alone). It looks for:
archive_ach_modal_log: Checked for you from purely your recorded campaign logs. It looks for:
archive_standalone_logs_hint: In Standalone Mode the guide says to "remember" these instead of recording them — but you can still record this scenario's entries here if you like.
archive_export_help: Share this campaign as a compressed .ahlifecam file, or export plain .json for inspection.
archive_export_done: Campaign exported — give the file to another player to import.
archive_standalone_list_description: One-off scenarios played in Standalone Mode — Scenario Packs and campaign scenarios played outside their campaign.
archive_no_standalones: No Standalone Archives yet. Create one with “New Standalone Archive”.
archive_guest_help: A guest keeps their own arkham.life. Their name and portrait here are frozen labels you chose.
archive_add_participant_no_roster: No other players yet — players you create show up here to add.
archive_add_guest_help: If they keep their own arkham.life, ask them to read out their UID (it's on their Manage Players page) so their results can be recognised across files. For a one-off guest — someone without the app whom you may never record again — just leave the UID blank. Either way, the name and portrait you pick are labels for your own records.
archive_guest_uid_invalid: A UID looks like ABC-2DE-FGH (no O, 0, I, or 1).
archive_solo_hands_help: Give each deck a hand number (1–4) below — distinct hands make it "Solo X-Handed".
archive_deck_standalone_trimmed: A standalone deck must be a single deck with no upgrades — kept the latest version only.
archive_deck_xp_over_title: A standalone deck may not include 50+ XP worth of cards.
archive_add_investigator_help: Add an investigator without a full deck — useful when deck data is unavailable.
archive_conflict_disjoint: Recorded in both {sections} — keep each card in only one:
archive_conflict_exclusive: These are mutually exclusive; keep only one:
archive_keys_borne_by_investigator: Borne by one of your investigators
archive_partner_survivors: The survivors of the expedition were ({count}/{total})
archive_extra_intro: Extra per-scenario data that will enrich certain widgets in the profile. These can't be known from the campaign log, but if you use ArkhamCards guided campaign, you can go into each scenario and see them.
archive_extra_picker_no_decks: Record this campaign's investigator decks to assign each drawn card to who drew it.
archive_side_story_help: Side Story scenarios you played at some point during this campaign. We record what you played (in order), not where. Note each one's victory display and resolution like a regular scenario.
archive_side_story_logs_hint: Add this standalone's log entries in the Logs tab — they appear in the Campaign Notes dropdown, recorded in play order.
